Negative ncomch is treated as zero by CSPICE; empty internal name is actual EMPTYSTRING, while blanks are permitted and long names truncate to60. Returns a backend-owned opaque writer token; VirtualOutput has backend-local namespace/readability bookkeeping.

routines.fixtureRationale: Three tiny synthetic SPKs cover complete polynomial states, signed IDs/negative center, gaps, overlapping file priority and empty outputs. Writer workflows independently generate their own Scratch files through the target raw method and actual SpiceyPy. Existing CK only establishes wrong-file-type errors. Persisted output assertions inspect every state word and metadata, not just a length/prefix.
routines.cleanup: Workflow writer labels are unique before acquisition. Explicit successful close removes the claim only after real close; captured empty-close failure retains it for actual recovery. Pending populated SPKs reset captured error, close before Scratch and retain failed claims for a registered retry. Actual Python starts with failed:true and observes reset before close. Both backends verify close attempts while Scratch exists. Native internal disposal closes an otherwise-empty underlying DAF after structured NOSEGMENTSFOUND without changing raw close behavior. Fatal close I/O remains best-effort and failed claims are not falsely reported as closed. All16actual WASM allocation failure positions have zero net leaked temporaries and permit genuine post-failure calls.
routines.tolerance: Unchanged live1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparison applies to every state/light-time/time endpoint; IDs and all six packed integer fields are meaningfully distinguished. Independent persisted24state-word/header/degree/count comparisons are exact; polynomial evaluation checks position with1e-9km and velocity1e-12km/s for interpolation versus direct formula roundoff, stronger than the live relative position bound. No global tolerance change.

findings.summary: Shared C rejected CSPICE negative comment defaults and intercepted empty strings with generic errors; WASM leaked its first string when the second encoder allocation failed. Writer numbers/states could be coerced or unbounded before native reserve.
findings.repair: Let actual CSPICE handle negative comment default/empty strings while retaining pointer safety. Protect every earlier string allocation. Signed integer/finite state/time guards and the existing256MiB budget reject oversized arrays before element reads/FFI. All16actual file/writer allocation positions pass, including two observed leaking positions; owning pinned WASM regeneration carries C changes to both targets.

routines.semantics: Close a populated SPK writer. CSPICE NOSEGMENTSFOUND on an empty writer leaves it open for recovery by writing data and retrying close. Public owned opaque token policy rejects expired/foreign handles; this differs intentionally from raw numeric CK unknown-unload behavior. Disposal may close an empty underlying DAF without changing raw SPKCLS semantics.

Persisted output assertions inspect every state word and metadata, not just a length/prefix.
routines.cleanup: Workflow writer labels are unique before acquisition. Explicit successful close removes the claim only after real close; captured empty-close failure retains it for actual recovery. Pending populated SPKs reset captured error, close before Scratch and retain failed claims for a registered retry. Actual Python starts with failed:true and observes reset before close. Both backends verify close attempts while Scratch exists. Native internal disposal closes an otherwise-empty underlying DAF after structured NOSEGMENTSFOUND without changing raw close behavior. Fatal close I/O remains best-effort and failed claims are not falsely reported as closed. All16actual WASM allocation failure positions have zero net leaked temporaries and permit genuine post-failure calls.
routines.tolerance: Unchanged live1e-12 absolute-or-relative comparison applies to every state/light-time/time endpoint; IDs and all six packed integer fields are meaningfully distinguished. Independent persisted24state-word/header/degree/count comparisons are exact; polynomial evaluation checks position with1e-9km and velocity1e-12km/s for interpolation versus direct formula roundoff, stronger than the live relative position bound. No global tolerance change.

findings.summary: Existing void or minimal open/query/close smoke examples did not establish full persisted values, physical file identity, state/error recovery or relevant capacity/metadata boundaries.
findings.repair: Successful close enables real append/query. A structured empty-close error is captured, its actual handle retained, valid data written and close retried, then complete state/descriptor read back. Public readable-output gate stays closed after failed close. Forty-four new registered workflows plus independent actual output/cleanup/ownership tests establish the observed raw effects. Shared SPKSFS descriptor output now exposes all six packed integers and can feed actual SPKUDS; full search semantics remain the separate eight-routine batch.

findings.summary: Scratch was removed before pending writer finalizers, close failures were forgotten, and Native disposeAll failed to release an empty SPK DAF handle after NOSEGMENTSFOUND.
findings.repair: Reset captured error, close pending claims before Scratch, retain failed claims for registered retry and reject duplicate workflow labels before acquisition. Actual Node/WASM/locked Python cleanup tests failed before and pass after repair. Native disposal handles only structured NOSEGMENTSFOUND with DAF close; raw SPKCLS still errors/retains the handle. A test captures the actual native handle and proves DAFBFS rejects it after disposal.

routines.semantics: Write a type8 segment from flat record-major [x,y,z,dx,dy,dz] states in km and km/s, regular ET-second sampling epoch1/step, valid descriptor bounds and degree1..27. Derive n=length/6 and require n>=degree+1. Frame and segment ID follow CSPICE; all40 ID bytes are retained and trailing blank beyond40 is allowed. N0067 permits body0 and equal body/center here, unlike SPKPDS; do not invent stricter constructor semantics.
